pinterest.title: HTTP Status Codes Poster | Funny Dark Mode Backend Wall Art
pinterest.description: A dark-mode poster explaining HTTP status codes the honest way: 200 OK, 400 your fault, 500 my fault. Printable wall art for developer offices and coding setups.
pinterest.altText: Dark mode poster reading 200 | 400 | 500 with a crashed server icon in green, for developer office decor.
